entry.en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una validez de al menos 6 meses después de la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Peru, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: At international airports, your entry is registered digitally through a Tarjeta Andina de Migración (TAM), a virtual immigration control document.
entry.es: En los aeropuertos internacionales tu entrada se registra digitalmente mediante la Tarjeta Andina de Migración (TAM), un documento virtual de control migratorio.
entry.quote: authorities will register your entry digitally through a Tarjeta Andina de Migración (TAM) - a virtual immigration control document.

entry.en: If you enter by land, you must get a passport entry stamp at the immigration checkpoint, as you cannot leave Peru without one.
entry.es: Si entras por tierra, debes obtener el sello de entrada en el puesto migratorio, pues no puedes salir de Perú sin él.
entry.quote: get a passport entry stamp at the immigration checkpoint. You cannot leave Peru without one.

entry.en: Passengers transiting or connecting through Lima airport are required to pay a fee called TUUA, which is not currently included in airline tickets.
entry.es: Los pasajeros en tránsito o conexión por el aeropuerto de Lima deben pagar una tasa llamada TUUA, que actualmente no está incluida en los billetes.
entry.quote: This fee is not currently included in airline tickets.

entry.en: You can bring one laptop and 2 mobile phones into Peru without paying tax.
entry.es: Puedes ingresar a Perú una laptop y 2 teléfonos móviles sin pagar impuestos.
entry.quote: You can bring one laptop and 2 mobile phones into Peru without paying tax.

entry.en: Removing archaeological artefacts from Peru without authorisation is illegal.
entry.es: Sacar artefactos arqueológicos de Perú sin autorización es ilegal.
entry.quote: It is illegal to remove any archaeological artefacts from Peru without authorisation.

safety.en: Street crime, including muggings and thefts, is a significant problem in Lima, Cusco, Arequipa and other major cities.
safety.es: Los delitos callejeros, incluidos atracos y robos, son un problema importante en Lima, Cusco, Arequipa y otras grandes ciudades.
safety.quote: Street crime, including muggings and thefts, is a significant problem in Lima, Cusco, Arequipa and other major cities.

safety.en: There is a risk of robbery by criminals posing as taxi drivers, especially at Jorge Chavez International Airport and bus terminals.
safety.es: Hay riesgo de robo por parte de delincuentes que se hacen pasar por taxistas, sobre todo en el aeropuerto Jorge Chávez y en las terminales de autobuses.
safety.quote: There is a risk of robbery by criminals posing as taxi drivers, especially at Jorge Chavez International Airport and bus terminals.

safety.en: Tourists, especially those travelling alone, are at risk of ‘express kidnapping’, in which victims are forced to withdraw money from ATMs.
safety.es: Los turistas, sobre todo quienes viajan solos, corren riesgo de ‘secuestro exprés’, en que se obliga a las víctimas a retirar dinero de cajeros.
safety.quote: Tourists, especially those travelling alone, are at risk of ‘express kidnapping’. Victims are taken hostage and forced to withdraw money from ATMs for their release, usually at night.

safety.en: It is illegal for foreigners to participate in political activities, including demonstrations, and you may face detention or deportation.
safety.es: Es ilegal que los extranjeros participen en actividades políticas, incluidas manifestaciones, y se arriesgan a detención o deportación.
safety.quote: It’s illegal for foreigners in Peru to participate in political activities, including demonstrations against the government. You may face detention or deportation if you take part in a demonstration.

safety.en: There have been deaths and serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Peru.
safety.es: Ha habido muertes y casos graves de enfermedad por bebidas alcohólicas con metanol en Perú.
safety.quote: There have been deaths and cases of serious illness caused by alcoholic drinks containing methanol in Peru.

safety.en: Peru is in an active earthquake zone and there are frequent tremors.
safety.es: Perú está en una zona sísmica activa y hay temblores frecuentes.
safety.quote: Peru is in an active earthquake zone and there are frequent tremors.

health.en: Altitude sickness is a serious risk in parts of Peru, including Cusco, Puno, the Colca Canyon and Kuelap.
health.es: El mal de altura es un riesgo grave en partes de Perú, como Cusco, Puno, el Cañón del Colca y Kuélap.
health.quote: Altitude sickness is a serious risk in parts of Peru, including Cusco, Puno, the Colca Canyon and Kuelap.

health.en: Diarrhoea caused by contaminated food or water is common and potentially serious.
health.es: La diarrea causada por comida o agua contaminada es común y potencialmente grave.
health.quote: Diarrhoea caused by contaminated food or water is common and is potentially serious.

health.en: Tap water is unsafe to drink or use for brushing your teeth unless you boil it.
health.es: El agua del grifo no es segura para beber ni para lavarse los dientes a menos que se hierva.
health.quote: Tap water is unsafe to drink or use for brushing your teeth in Peru, unless you boil it.

health.en: Yellow fever vaccine is recommended for travellers visiting forest areas (Amazonia) below 2,300 m, but not for coast or highlands only.
health.es: Se recomienda la vacuna contra la fiebre amarilla para quienes visiten zonas selváticas (Amazonía) por debajo de 2.300 m, pero no si solo se visitan costa o sierra.
health.quote: Travellers that only visit coast or highlands do not need the vaccine for yellow fever.

health.en: Medical treatment is not easily available and can be more difficult to access outside of Lima.
health.es: El tratamiento médico no es fácil de conseguir y puede ser más difícil de acceder fuera de Lima.
health.quote: Medical treatment is not easily available and can be more difficult to access outside of Lima.

health.en: Peru is experiencing a major dengue outbreak following floods.
health.es: Perú sufre un brote importante de dengue tras las inundaciones.
health.quote: Peru is experiencing a major dengue outbreak following floods.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 106, fire 116 and police 105.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 106, bomberos 116 y policía 105.

help.en: Wikivoyage says to dial 911 for all emergency services, though the old 105 can also connect you with the police.
help.es: Wikivoyage indica marcar el 911 para todos los servicios de emergencia, aunque el antiguo 105 también comunica con la policía.
help.quote: Dial 911 for all emergency services, but dialing the old 105 can also connect you with the police.

getting_in.en: Lima's Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM) has frequent flights to and from all over the world.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Jorge Chávez de Lima (LIM) tiene vuelos frecuentes desde y hacia todo el mundo.
getting_in.quote: The capital city of Lima has Jorge Chávez International Airport (LIM IATA) with frequent flights to/from all over the world.

getting_in.en: Cuzco has only one direct international flight, from Colombia, Bolivia and Chile.
getting_in.es: Cuzco solo tiene un vuelo internacional directo, desde Colombia, Bolivia y Chile.
getting_in.quote: The city of Cuzco has only one direct international flight from Colombia, Bolivia and Chile.

getting_in.en: There are international buses connecting Peru to Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile and Colombia.
getting_in.es: Hay autobuses internacionales que conectan Perú con Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile y Colombia.
getting_in.quote: There are international buses connecting Peru to the neighboring countries of Bolivia, Ecuador, Chile and Colombia.

getting_in.en: To and from Lima airport, using the Airport Express Lima bus or a taxi booked at a company desk in arrivals is strongly recommended.
getting_in.es: Desde y hacia el aeropuerto de Lima se recomienda mucho el bus Airport Express Lima o un taxi reservado en un mostrador de empresa en llegadas.
getting_in.quote: it is strongly recommended to use the luxury Airport Express Lima bus to get to or from your hotel, or to book and pay for your taxi at one of the taxi company desks inside the arrivals area.

getting_in.en: Only cross the Peru-Ecuador land border at official checkpoints, as other parts may still have unexploded landmines.
getting_in.es: Cruza la frontera terrestre Perú-Ecuador solo por puestos oficiales, pues otras zonas podrían tener minas sin explotar.
getting_in.quote: Only cross the Peru-Ecuador land border at official checkpoints. Other parts of the border may still have unexploded landmines.

getting_around.en: Flying is described as the most convenient way to get around Peru, with most major destinations one to one and a half hours from Lima.
getting_around.es: Volar se describe como la forma más cómoda de moverse por Perú, con casi todos los destinos principales a una hora u hora y media de Lima.
getting_around.quote: Almost all major tourist destinations outside Lima are between one and one and a half hours by plane from the capital. Flying is the most convenient way for getting around Peru.

getting_around.en: Lima to Cuzco takes 21 hours by bus or 1½ hours by plane.
getting_around.es: De Lima a Cuzco son 21 horas en autobús o 1½ horas en avión.

getting_around.en: Taxi fares are generally not fixed or metered but negotiated with the driver before getting in.
getting_around.es: Las tarifas de taxi generalmente no son fijas ni van por taxímetro, sino que se negocian con el conductor antes de subir.
getting_around.quote: the fare is not fixed or metered, but it is negotiated with the driver before getting into the vehicle.

getting_around.en: City buses cost S/0.70-1.50, and taxis S/7-8 in Lima, normally less in other cities.
getting_around.es: Los buses urbanos cuestan S/0.70-1.50 y los taxis S/7-8 en Lima, normalmente menos en otras ciudades.
getting_around.quote: Buses cost S/0.70-1.50 (soles) inside a city, taxis S/7-8 in Lima, normally less in other cities.

getting_around.en: Micros are common but known for being quite dangerous, and it is advised not to take one.
getting_around.es: Los micros son muy comunes pero se les conoce por ser bastante peligrosos, y se aconseja no tomarlos.
getting_around.quote: Micros are very common but known for being quite dangerous, and different government programs are trying to reduce the number of micros. It is advised to not take a micro.

getting_around.en: Bus crashes are common, especially at night, so use reputable companies and avoid overnight travel where possible.
getting_around.es: Los accidentes de bus son comunes, sobre todo de noche; usa empresas de renombre y evita viajar de noche cuando sea posible.
getting_around.quote: Bus crashes are common, especially at night. Only use reputable transport companies, and where possible, avoid overnight travel

money.en: The currency is the sol (PEN), symbolised S/, and is one of the more stable currencies in South America.
money.es: La moneda es el sol (PEN), simbolizado S/, y es una de las más estables de Sudamérica.
money.quote: The currency of Peru is the sol (ISO code: PEN), symbolised as S/. It is one of the more stable currencies in South America.

money.en: Per-transaction ATM withdrawal limits are generally low and withdrawal fees are high.
money.es: Los límites de retiro por transacción en cajeros suelen ser bajos y las comisiones altas.
money.quote: The per-transaction withdrawal limits are generally low and withdrawal fees are high (Feb 2018):

money.en: Cash is generally the only option at budget hotels, corner shops and bakeries, and some businesses add a surcharge of up to 6% for cards.
money.es: El efectivo suele ser la única opción en hoteles económicos, tiendas de barrio y panaderías, y algunos negocios cobran hasta 6% extra por tarjeta.
money.quote: one should generally expect that only cash is accepted at a 40-soles-a-night budget hotel (or even an international backpackers' hostel), a corner shop (bodega), or a bakery (panaderia).

money.en: Small bills are very helpful to carry, as merchants and taxi drivers often claim not to have change.
money.es: Conviene llevar billetes pequeños, pues comerciantes y taxistas suelen decir que no tienen cambio.
money.quote: Typically, small bills are very helpful to carry around. Change large bills into small ones as often as possible.

money.en: Counterfeit US and Peruvian banknotes are in circulation.
money.es: Circulan billetes falsos de dólares estadounidenses y de soles.
money.quote: Counterfeit US and Peruvian banknotes are in circulation.

money.en: Tipping is not practiced in taxis.
money.es: No se acostumbra dar propina en los taxis.
money.quote: Tipping is not practiced in taxis.

etiquette.en: Avoid the word indio, which is very offensive to natives; el indígena or la indígena is the polite form.
etiquette.es: Evita la palabra indio, muy ofensiva para los nativos; la forma correcta es el indígena o la indígena.
etiquette.quote: Don't use the word indio, even though it's Spanish.

etiquette.en: Chewing coca leaves is part of the culture, and the leaves are legal in Peru, but they are considered drugs in other countries so never take them across the border.
etiquette.es: Mascar hojas de coca forma parte de la cultura y son legales en Perú, pero se consideran drogas en otros países, así que nunca las cruces por la frontera.
etiquette.quote: However, coca leaves and its derivative products are considered drugs in other countries, so you should never bring them across the border.

etiquette.en: At temple ruins or other ritual places, behave as if you were in a church.
etiquette.es: En ruinas de templos u otros lugares rituales, compórtate como si estuvieras en una iglesia.
etiquette.quote: Respect that when visiting temple ruins or other ritual places and behave as if you were in a church.

etiquette.en: Avoid charged topics of conversation and stay away from demonstrations or strikes, which often degenerate into severe violence.
etiquette.es: Evita temas de conversación delicados y mantente lejos de manifestaciones o huelgas, que suelen degenerar en violencia grave.
etiquette.quote: try to stay away from demonstrations or strikes, as they often degenerate into severe violence, both by the demonstrators and the police.

etiquette.en: Do not photograph anything of a military nature, as it is illegal and could bring a prison sentence of two to five years.
etiquette.es: No fotografíes nada de carácter militar, pues es ilegal y puede acarrear una pena de dos a cinco años de prisión.
etiquette.quote: Do not take photographs of anything of a military nature, it is illegal and you could face a prison sentence of two to five years.

etiquette.en: Always carry ID with you, as police may ask to see it.
etiquette.es: Lleva siempre contigo tu documento de identidad, pues la policía puede pedirlo.
etiquette.quote: Always carry ID with you. The Peruvian police may ask to see ID

connectivity.en: Internet cafés called cabinas públicas are easy to find outside the countryside and are cheap, at S/1.50-3 per hour.
connectivity.es: Los cibercafés, llamados cabinas públicas, son fáciles de encontrar fuera del campo y baratos, a S/1.50-3 por hora.
connectivity.quote: Internet cafés, called in Peru cabinas públicas, grow like mushrooms in Peru and if you are not really on the countryside, it should not be a problem at all to find one.

connectivity.en: A locutorio, or call-center, is an attractive alternative to public phones, which can be expensive.
connectivity.es: Un locutorio, o call-center, es una alternativa atractiva a los teléfonos públicos, que pueden ser caros.
connectivity.quote: Many public phones can be expensive, and an attractive alternative is a Locutorio, or "call-center".
